name: io.github.tagpilot/ga4-mcp
title: Tag Pilot GA4
description: Free, read-only Google Analytics 4: reports, funnels, realtime. Sign in with Google, no GCP setup.

environmentVariables.name: TAGPILOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free Tag Pilot API key (tpk_…) from the GA4 MCP page at https://app.tagpilot.io/ga4-mcp

environmentVariables.name: GA4_MCP_OAUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed local port (1024-65535) for the Google sign-in callback, e.g. for SSH port forwarding. Default: random.

environmentVariables.name: GA4_MCP_NO_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to only return the Google sign-in URL instead of opening a browser.

environmentVariables.name: GA4_MCP_AUTH_WAIT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a tool call waits for the browser sign-in before returning the link.
